title: Longest Repeating Substring
description: Given a string `s`, return *the length of the longest repeating substrings*. If no repeating substring exists, return `0`.

examples.explanation: The longest repeating substrings are "ab" and "ba", each of which occurs twice.
The longest repeating substring is "aab", which occurs 3 times.

constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Longest Repeating Substring.
